summary: Use except ... as e syntax for Python 2.6+ and 3; the comma form fails on all Python 3 versions.
questions: What exception syntax works on both Python 2 and 3?

answer_card.title: Catch exceptions with as
answer_card.answer_md:
```python
try:
    a = 2/0
except ValueError as e:
    module.fail_json(msg="Tried to divide by zero: %s" % e)
```
Never use `except ValueError, e:`; it fails on every Python 3.
